overview.location: Oakland, California — about 7 miles south of downtown Oakland and 12 miles east of San Francisco, off I-880 via Hegenberger Road / Airport Drive. Formerly Metropolitan Oakland International Airport; renamed Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport in July 2025 after a 2024 rename ('San Francisco Bay Oakland International Airport') was blocked by a November 2024 injunction won by San Francisco (SFO). The dispute was settled in April 2026: OAK keeps 'Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport' and its IATA code, 'Oakland' must come first, and the name drops 'International'.
overview.distinction: The East Bay's main airport and, per the Port of Oakland, the closest airport to a majority of Bay Area residents. Southwest carries ~78% of passengers (Aug 2025-Jul 2026) and has an operating base here. FedEx Express runs a West Coast cargo hub on the airport. Linked to BART by the Oakland Airport Connector (opened 2014). Not affiliated with San Francisco International (SFO).
overview.totalAirlines: Southwest, Alaska, Delta Connection, Frontier, Hawaiian, Volaris, Volaris El Salvador, Advanced Air and JSX (JSX from its own facility) — check iflyoak.com/fly/wherewefly for the current list
overview.metroAccess: BART Oakland Airport Connector: Oakland Airport station across the street from the terminals, ~8-9 minutes to Coliseum station (links to the whole BART system). AC Transit Line 73 (every 15 min, ~4:56 a.m.-12:06 a.m.) and late-night Line 805 (hourly ~12:35-4:30 a.m.) to Coliseum BART.
overview.peopleMover: None inside the terminals — Terminals 1 and 2 are connected on foot; the BART connector is an automated guideway to Coliseum station, not an inter-terminal train.

terminals.name: Terminal 1
terminals.notes: Handles all non-precleared international arrivals. Escape Lounge is here, near Gate 8 (between Gates 8 and 8A, across from Gate 9) — open to passengers of any airline by booking.

terminals.name: Terminal 2
terminals.notes: Southwest-only terminal. Trader Vic's and Plum Market opened here October 15, 2026. From the Daily, Hourly and Premier lots, Terminal 2 is on the far side of the elevated BART station.

groundTransportZones.rentalCarShuttle: Rental Car Shuttle: 3rd curb outside Terminals 1 and 2 (Stops 3A and 3D).
groundTransportZones.offAirportParkingShuttles: Off-airport parking shuttles pick up at the 4th curb — Airpark's listing gives Section 4F.
groundTransportZones.parkAndCall: Park & Call waiting lot: free for up to 30 minutes; passenger pickup is not allowed in the lot — meet passengers at the first curb in front of Terminals 1 and 2.

routes: Oakland Airport Connector: Oakland Airport station <-> Coliseum station
bart.hours: Weekdays 5 a.m.-midnight, Saturdays 6 a.m.-midnight, Sundays 8 a.m.-midnight
bart.frequency: About every 6 minutes in the daytime, every 20 minutes 11 p.m.-midnight
bart.fare: Mileage-based BART fare with an airport surcharge — use BART's fare calculator; Clipper, contactless cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay accepted
bart.accessFromTerminal: The BART station is across the street from the terminals.

routes: Line 73 (OAK - Coliseum BART, every 15 min, ~4:56 a.m.-12:06 a.m.)
Line 805 (late-night, hourly ~12:35-4:30 a.m., OAK - Coliseum BART - downtown Oakland)

rideshare.note: Confirm the car and driver match the app before getting in.

rentalCars.location: Rental Car Center, 7600 Earhart Road, Oakland, CA 94621 (North Field), reached by the Rental Car Shuttle from the 3rd curb (Stops 3A and 3D). Waits typically ~10 minutes, up to 20; buses staged at both ends 11:30 PM-4 AM. Shuttle questions: 510-453-1522.
rentalCars.note: Counter hours: Hertz/Dollar/Thrifty 6 AM-1 AM; Avis/Budget 6 AM-11 PM; Enterprise/Alamo/National 7 AM-10:30 PM.

amtrak.station: Oakland Jack London Square (not at the airport)
amtrak.service: Capitol Corridor, Coast Starlight, California Zephyr
amtrak.note: No direct airport link — combine with BART/AC Transit or rideshare.

groundTransportation.hotelShuttles: Triply's three OAK lots are 1.3-1.7 mi from the terminals on 98th Avenue and Hegenberger Road. Airpark's shuttle loops the 4th curb (Section 4F); Express Park Fly (510-899-2014) and Spring Park (510-333-6603) are on demand — call after you collect your bags.

parkingRates: On-airport (24-hour max, incl. 20% City of Oakland Parking Tax): Economy $18 ($3 per 30 min, shuttle), Daily $26 ($4 per 30 min, walk), Hourly $36 ($4 per 30 min), Premier $40 ($5 per 30 min, in front of the terminals). Park & Call free 30 minutes. Off-site via Triply: Express Park Fly and Spring Park from ~$6.95/day, Airpark Oakland ~$12/day.

economyLot.name: OAK Economy Lot
economyLot.rate: $18/day ($3 per 30 minutes; daily max reached after 2 hours)
economyLot.location: Long-term lot beyond the Daily lot
economyLot.connection: Free shuttle buses from 7 stops in the lot, every 15-20 minutes. Overnight service is on demand at 510-563-3890 (the airport's pages give both 11 PM-5 AM and 2-5 AM as the on-demand window — tell readers to check the shelter sign).
economyLot.features: Lowest-cost on-airport option. Free EV charging at M1.

dailyLot.name: OAK Daily Lot
dailyLot.rate: $26/day ($4 per 30 minutes; daily max after 2 hours)
dailyLot.serves: Terminals 1 and 2 (5-8 minute walk on protected walkways)
dailyLot.features: Quick Gate reservations-only lane: reserve, add your plate, the camera opens the gate (front plate required). Free EV charging at L6. No shuttle.

hourlyLot.name: OAK Hourly Lot
hourlyLot.features: ADA placard holders without a reservation can pay the Daily rate by exiting through the cashier lane with placard and ID.

premierLot.name: OAK Premier Lot
premierLot.rate: $40/day ($5 per 30 minutes; daily max after 2 hours)
premierLot.serves: Directly in front of the terminals (walk)
premierLot.features: Closest parking. Most free EV chargers (G2, J2, K2).

cellPhoneLot.name: Park & Call
cellPhoneLot.rules: Wait in your vehicle; no passenger pickup in the lot — meet passengers at the first curb in front of Terminals 1 and 2. For longer waits use the Hourly Lot.

evCharging.note: Level 2 cords provided; bring your own cord for Level 1. EV stalls limited to 30 days; non-EVs in EV stalls are towed.

onAirportParking.reservations: Book at book.iflyoak.com at least 2 hours ahead ('discounted rates' — amounts unpublished); $1.99 service fee; modify/cancel up to 4 hours ahead; guarantees entry; no partial refunds for early exit; overstays billed at the regular rate. Departing-flight delay/cancellation refunds by email with proof.
onAirportParking.accessibleParking: ADA spaces in all lots along protected walkways. Hourly Lot: placard holders without a reservation pay the Daily rate via the cashier lane. Regular rates in Economy and Premier.
onAirportParking.paymentMethods: Cash; Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express, Diners Club; Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay. 'Credit Card In and Out' can't be combined with coupons or promotions. Rates include the 20% City of Oakland Parking Tax.
onAirportParking.oversizedVehicles: RVs and motorhomes allowed — charged by the number of spaces used. Trucks and SUVs use the right exit lane (taller scanner). Motorcycles allowed.
onAirportParking.receipts: Reservation confirmation email is the receipt; download from Manage Booking or use iflyoak.com/park/request-a-receipt; overstay receipts from the pay machine before exit.
onAirportParking.parkingContact: Parking help, jump starts, lockouts: 510-563-3200; Economy on-demand shuttle: 510-563-3890
onAirportParking.garageServiceAreas: Premier, Hourly and Daily → walk to Terminals 1 and 2. Economy → shuttle.

parkingLots.name: Express Park Fly
parkingLots.parkingType: Self-park (fenced, gated lot; outdoor and indoor options per listing)
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24/7, on demand. Check in with on-site staff on arrival and show your reservation. On return, call 510-899-2014 after collecting your bags to request pickup.
parkingLots.overview: Fully fenced and gated lot about 5 minutes from OAK with security cameras and on-site staff, open and staffed 24/7. Listing says outdoor and indoor parking options are available.
parkingLots.notes: Lowest grand total at OAK on 2026-10-16: $75.50 for a 7-night Nov 2-9 stay (8 billed days; $55.60 subtotal + fees + 20% tax); same on Nov 9-16 and 16-23. The listing mentions indoor parking but does not say a Triply booking gets a covered space — do not promise covered parking.

parkingLots.name: Spring Park Airport Parking
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24/7, on demand. Check in with an attendant at the entrance and show your confirmation number (phone is fine); you get a parking ticket — keep it, you need it to retrieve your car. Arrive at least 20 minutes before you want to be at the airport. On return, call 510-333-6603 after collecting luggage.
parkingLots.overview: Lot on Hegenberger Road minutes from Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport with a 24/7 on-demand shuttle; staff guide you to a space.
parkingLots.notes: $76.50 grand total for Nov 2-9 (8 billed days), same on all three test weeks. Same $6.95/day as Express Park Fly but $1 more in fees. Listing description says '0.5 miles' of drive; Triply's search measures 1.4 mi — use 1.4 mi.

parkingLots.name: Airpark Oakland Parking
parkingLots.parkingType: Self-park (valet at no extra charge when near capacity)
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24 hours, departing every 10 minutes to the airport. Arrive 15 minutes before you plan to be at the terminal. On return, go to the off-airport parking pickup area at the 4th curb, Section 4F; buses rotate continuously until midnight — after that, or if you can't find the shuttle, call 510-568-1221.
parkingLots.overview: Long-standing lot (serving travelers since 1979) about a 5-minute drive east of OAK, with a 24/7 front desk, 24-hour surveillance and a complimentary shuttle included with every online reservation.
parkingLots.specialConditions: No RVs, no Sprinter vans, no dually trucks.
parkingLots.notes: $121.16 grand total for Nov 2-9 (8 billed days), same on all three test weeks. Must be booked at least 24 hours ahead. Only Triply OAK lot with a scheduled (every-10-minute) shuttle and a fixed curb pickup (4F); after midnight call for pickup. Wheelchair access listed.

parkingLots.name: Park 'N Fly Oakland
parkingLots.notes: Major off-airport operator on 98th Avenue. Not sold on Triply — comparison only; never use as a CTA.

parkingLots.name: VIP Airport Parking
parkingLots.notes: Off-airport operator on Hegenberger Road. Not sold on Triply — comparison only; never use as a CTA.

shuttleInfo: On-airport: Economy Lot shuttle every 15-20 minutes from 7 stops, on demand overnight (510-563-3890); Daily, Hourly and Premier are walkable. Off-site: Triply's three OAK lots are 1.3-1.7 mi away and all run 24/7 — Express Park Fly and Spring Park on demand (call after bags), Airpark every 10 minutes from the 4th curb (Section 4F), continuous until midnight then call 510-568-1221.
distanceFromCity: About 7 miles south of downtown Oakland and 12 miles east of San Francisco.

keyDistances.toDowntownOakland: ~7 miles; BART via Coliseum, AC Transit 805 late night
keyDistances.toSanFrancisco: ~12 miles (across the Bay Bridge); BART via Coliseum
keyDistances.to98thAveLots: 1.3-1.7 mi (Triply lots: Airpark Oakland, Express Park Fly)
keyDistances.toHegenbergerLot: 1.4 mi (Triply lot: Spring Park Airport Parking)
keyDistances.competitiveAdvantage: All three Triply OAK lots sit within 1.7 miles of the terminals off Hegenberger Road and 98th Avenue and all run 24/7 shuttles; two of them cost less than half of OAK's $18/day Economy Lot over a week.

construction2026.travelImpact: No parking facility closures identified as of 2026-10-16 — tell readers to check iflyoak.com before travel.

tsaPreCheck.note: TSA PreCheck — enroll at tsa.gov/precheck; check lane hours in the MyTSA app

arrivalRecommendation.domestic: At least 2 hours before departure (standard airline guidance)
arrivalRecommendation.holidays: 2.5-3 hours around Thanksgiving, Christmas and spring break

securityAndScreening.note: Southwest flights use Terminal 2 (and some Terminal 1 gates); check your boarding pass for the terminal before choosing where to be dropped off. Checkpoint hours, CLEAR and wait times are not published on iflyoak.com — use the MyTSA app.

terminal1.name: Escape Lounge
terminal1.location: Terminal 1, near Gate 8 (between Gates 8 and 8A, across from Gate 9)
terminal1.access: Open to all passengers on any airline and class — register and book through iflyoak.com/visit/escape-lounge

lounges.other: Escape Lounge (Terminal 1) is the only lounge listed on iflyoak.com.

peakTravelTimes.seasonalPeak: Summer, spring break, Thanksgiving and Christmas/New Year. Top domestic routes (Aug 2025-Jul 2026): Las Vegas, San Diego, Burbank, Seattle/Tacoma, Phoenix.

weatherPatterns.climate: Mild Mediterranean: cool, wet winters and dry summers moderated by San Francisco Bay.
weatherPatterns.commonDisruptions: Winter rainstorms (atmospheric rivers), morning fog and low clouds around the Bay; occasional delays tied to Bay Area air traffic flow programs.
weatherPatterns.winterNote: No snow — rain is the main issue. Allow extra time on I-880 in wet weather.
weatherPatterns.note: Outdoor lots are fine year-round; covered parking mainly matters for sun and rain.

parkSleepFly.description: Triply sells parking-only at three OAK lots near Hegenberger Road and 98th Avenue; none of them is a hotel, so there are no room packages.

savingsComparison.scenario: 7-night trip (Nov 2-9, 2026, 10 AM drop-off / 2 PM pickup — Triply bills 8 days), quoted 2026-10-16. On-airport figures assume 8 days at the 24-hour max (tax included).

savingsComparison.keyDifference: OAK's cheapest official lot (Economy, $18/day) still costs about twice what Express Park Fly or Spring Park cost over a week. Airpark is the priciest Triply lot but still beats Economy by ~$23 and adds a scheduled every-10-minute shuttle. The airport's own online reservations advertise 'discounted rates' without publishing them — tell readers to check book.iflyoak.com.

uniqueFeatures.nameChange: Renamed 'San Francisco Bay Oakland International Airport' in May 2024; a federal injunction (Nov 2024) won by San Francisco blocked it. The Port adopted 'Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport' in July 2025, and an April 2026 settlement lets OAK keep that name — 'Oakland' must come first and 'San Francisco' can't be shown larger than 'Oakland'. Write 'Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport (OAK)' or 'Oakland airport'; never 'San Francisco Airport', 'SF Airport' or 'San Francisco Bay Oakland International'.
uniqueFeatures.bartConnector: BART's Oakland Airport Connector (2014) runs from across the street to Coliseum station in ~8-9 minutes.
uniqueFeatures.southwestBase: Southwest carries ~78% of OAK passengers and operates a base here; Terminal 2 is Southwest-only.
uniqueFeatures.fedexHub: FedEx Express has run a cargo hub at OAK since 1988.
uniqueFeatures.since1927: Opened in 1927; Amelia Earhart's final 1937 flight attempt departed from OAK's North Field.

emergencyContacts.emergency: 911 — state you are at Oakland airport (OAK)
